name: JoAi: Update Document

description.en: Update the title, content, metadata, public share state, or archive state of an existing document. Set public=true for a shareable link (url), archived=true to hide from knowledge (soft retire).
description.de: Titel, Inhalt, Metadaten, öffentliche Freigabe oder Archivstatus eines Dokuments aktualisieren. public=true erzeugt einen teilbaren Link (url), archived=true blendet es aus der Wissensbasis aus.
description.es: Update the title, content, metadata, public share state, or archive state of an existing document. Set public=true for a shareable link (url), archived=true to hide from knowledge (soft retire).
description.fr: Update the title, content, metadata, public share state, or archive state of an existing document. Set public=true for a shareable link (url), archived=true to hide from knowledge (soft retire).
description.ro: Update the title, content, metadata, public share state, or archive state of an existing document. Set public=true for a shareable link (url), archived=true to hide from knowledge (soft retire).
description.it: Update the title, content, metadata, public share state, or archive state of an existing document. Set public=true for a shareable link (url), archived=true to hide from knowledge (soft retire).

bot: Use this when the user wants to edit an existing document or template, share/unshare via public link, or archive/unarchive it. Prefer archived=true over delete for soft retirement. When public=true, return the url from the response.

inputs.name: Document ID

description.en: The ID of the document to update
description.de: Die ID des zu aktualisierenden Dokuments
description.es: The ID of the document to update
description.fr: The ID of the document to update
description.ro: The ID of the document to update
description.it: The ID of the document to update

inputs.bot: The hashid of the document to update.

inputs.name: Title
inputs.bot: Updated document title. Omit to keep the current title.

inputs.name: Content
inputs.bot: Updated document content. Omit to keep the current content.

inputs.name: Public

description.en: Share publicly ("true") or revoke share ("false"). Omit to leave unchanged.
description.de: Öffentlich teilen ("true") oder Freigabe widerrufen ("false"). Weglassen lässt den Status unverändert.
description.es: Share publicly ("true") or revoke share ("false"). Omit to leave unchanged.
description.fr: Share publicly ("true") or revoke share ("false"). Omit to leave unchanged.
description.ro: Share publicly ("true") or revoke share ("false"). Omit to leave unchanged.
description.it: Share publicly ("true") or revoke share ("false"). Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.bot: Set true to publish a shareable link (response includes url). Set false to unpublish. Omit to keep current visibility.

inputs.name: Archived

description.en: Archive ("true") or restore ("false"). Archived docs are hidden from knowledge and the default list.
description.de: Archivieren ("true") oder wiederherstellen ("false"). Archivierte Docs sind aus Wissen und Standardliste ausgeblendet.
description.es: Archive ("true") or restore ("false"). Archived docs are hidden from knowledge and the default list.
description.fr: Archive ("true") or restore ("false"). Archived docs are hidden from knowledge and the default list.
description.ro: Archive ("true") or restore ("false"). Archived docs are hidden from knowledge and the default list.
description.it: Archive ("true") or restore ("false"). Archived docs are hidden from knowledge and the default list.

inputs.bot: Set true to soft-retire a document (prefer over delete). Also revokes any public share link. Set false to restore. Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.bot: Integer step number in the sequence.
